newsitem.title: USA: EnviroSource to drop Horsehead lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: EnviroSource to drop Horsehead lawsuit.

text.p: EnviroSource Inc said on Thursday it intends to terminate the antitrust lawsuit it filed July 1995 against Horsehead Resource Development Company Inc.
EnviroSource dropped the lawsuit after it has increased its share of the electric arc furnace dust disposal market as mini steel mills increased demand for the service, it said.
EnviroSource said its lawsuit claimed that Horsehead monopolized the market processing and disposal of electric arc furnace dust by anticompetitive practices.
EnviroSource said it expects to process 200,000 tons of electric arc furnace dust in 1997 and there is no purpose in pursuing the costly litigation since its market share has expanded.
